description.value: White Spot is BC's longest-running restaurant chain, founded in 1928 and known for classic burgers made with fresh Canadian beef, fish and chips, milkshakes, and other comfort-food staples sourced from local BC producers. This Scott Road location sits near the 72nd Avenue intersection and operates as a full-service family restaurant with dine-in and takeout available. A touring cyclist stopping here will find a predictable, filling meal in a welcoming sit-down setting with a broad menu spanning breakfast through dinner.
